Name: A Little Smaller Falling Leaves
Author: KMago
Description:
[center]※ Sorry, I used Google Translate to write this.


This mod makes the plump leaves look smaller and slightly darker than their original color.
There are no other features.



There are three ways to install.

1) Install the mod, 2) Overwrite the XNB file, or 3) Merge it into a PNG file.

Install it however you want!


Thanks![/center]
